cards.title: Flow Record
cards.description: What moves through the system, including units, time scale, origin, destination, and boundary.

cards.title: Capacity Record
cards.description: Physical, operational, effective, regulatory, and stress-condition capacity assumptions.

cards.title: Queue Record
cards.description: Visible and hidden backlogs, waiting times, queue discipline, and service constraints.

cards.title: Bottleneck Record
cards.description: Limiting stages, downstream constraints, routing assumptions, and effective capacity.

cards.title: Maintenance Record
cards.description: Asset condition, capacity decay, repair rates, inspection uncertainty, and deferred maintenance.

cards.title: Resilience Record
cards.description: Buffers, redundancy, failure modes, cascading dependencies, and recovery rates.

cards.title: Claim Boundary
cards.description: Teaching, monitoring, scenario comparison, investment planning, emergency planning, or decision support.
